page.overview:
What is Force Stasis?

Force Stasis was a telekinetic Force power used to restrain and immobilize people or objects.

Force Stasis was an ability of the Force to forcibly restrain and immobilize people or to halt objects headed in a Force-user's direction. The ability allowed its users to cancel out the motion of a target, not only reducing its speed but even suspending it in place. The effect could at times be temporary, allowing the target to regain its motion, but could also be so powerful that, unlike normal applications of telekinesis, continuous conscious effort and physical gestures were not always necessary to maintain it. Additionally, the most skilled or powerful users could even exert this paralyzing grip on non-material objects, such as blaster bolts.

During the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY, the Wookiee Jukkyuk, a bodyguard for Mother Elecia Zeveron, was stirred into a frenzy by Guide Marda Ro, who convinced the Wookiee to battle with the Jedi Order so she could get through to Zeveron. Rushing through the tunnels, Jukkyuk soon encountered and fired upon three Jedi, Padawan Matthea Cathley, Jedi Knight Azlin Rell, and fellow Knight Oliviah Zeveron. Zeveron responded to the attack with an act of Force Stasis: with a simple raise of her hand, Zeveron stopped the incoming blaster bolt in its tracks and then pushed it back towards Jukkyuk, who fell to his own blast but survived.

Twin sisters Verosha and Mae-ho Aniseya used Force Stasis on a Brendoki flutterby on the planet Brendok in 148 BBY. Yoda used the power to freeze Asajj Ventress in place as she tried to kill King Katuunko in 22 BBY.
